text_block_list.text:
Голд Шип: The Ultimate Unsinkable
Battleship
(Epilogue)
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Fsshhh... Fsshhh...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The waves crash rhythmically on the
beach
beneath a reddening sky...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I look to my side, feeling relaxed and
content.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The Twinkle Series is over! Congrats to
all! Now,
time to let loose and wreak
havoc on the marine
ecosystem!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Голд Шипп makes a beeline for the water
with a
net at the ready.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I mentally retrace my steps, while
listening to the
sound of the waves.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Голд Шипп performed extremely well in
the
Twinkle Series, and we made it
through our first
three-year period
together in one piece.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I went to find her to congratulate her
and was met
with a scene of chaos.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Loot! Where's the loot?!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: Hey there, ATM―I mean, Trainer!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
All right, listen up. The adventurer
blood in my
veins awoke from its secret
hibernation without
warning!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
If I don't get my hands on some loot
soon, every
living thing'll start looking
like an ATM to me!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Right?! That's why I have to embark on
my
journey, now!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
You're coming too, right?! Hurry and get
your
stuff! We leave in sixty seconds!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
And so, I set off on an adventure with
Голд Шип...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Check out that fish! I've never seen
coloration
like that before. It might be
an undiscovered
species! Quick, grab it!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Whoa! That's one weird-looking stag
beetle! It'll
be worth a fortune if it's a
rare one! Careful with it
now!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: Dang, that hermit crab's massive! I bet it's a mutant, for sure! Don't let it get away!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
I'm not entirely sure how much time
passes...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But the next thing I know, we're on the
beach.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
We've been to tons of beaches together,
huh?
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
We were born of the sea and, in the
end, it is our
destiny to return to it...
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Though, I don't have a clue why we're
here now...
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
I belatedly remember why I was looking
for her in
the first place.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
There's still something important I have
to tell
her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Where'd that come from? What are you,
Sudden
Salutations Sam?
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип
choice_data_list:
I wanted to congratulate you because you've
worked so hard.

text_block_list.text:
The first three years are a key time for

Umamusume at Академия Тайсен.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Голд Шипп not only made it through all
three
years, she even made a name for
herself in the
process.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
...Wait, for realsies? That must mean I'm
really
awesome, huh?
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Aw, c'mon. You can do better than that.
Use your
diaphragm.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: Ugh, I'm saying...
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
You gotta say it like you mean it! C'mon,
get in
that celebratory mood and get
hyped!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
If you're gonna praise me, yell it loud
enough to
hurt the moon's ears!
CONGRATS! Like that!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
CONGRATS, CONGRATS, CONGRATS!
Aw yeah!
Time to terrorize the fish
population!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Next thing I know, Голд Шипп is sprinting
for the
water, yelling about catching a
sea bream.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Yes! I got one!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
She brings her fresh catch ashore, and
we eat it
together.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Phew, I'm stuffed. That sea bream was tasty.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Right? It was delicious in both fresh
sashimi form
and grilled skewer form.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
...You know what, Тренер? Nothing fazes
you
anymore.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Back when we first met, you would
totally freak
out over getting thrown
into a burlap sack and
carried off.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Maybe it's because of the sheer number
of wild
adventures Голд Шипп has
dragged me on, but I've
learned how to
just go with the flow.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
You should give yourself a pat on the
back. It's
not just anyone that can jive
with my biorhythm.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Anyway, phew! This night sure is
something, huh?
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: Fsshhh... Fsshhh...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Think the sea fireflies will be out soon?
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: Fsshhh... Fsshhh...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I wonder if I can find any constellations
in the
sky...
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Maybe it's just how tired I am, but the
sound of
the waves is so soothing. My
eyelids grow heavier
and heavier...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: ...Hm? Тренер? You alive? Hellooo?
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: Welp... Out cold, huh?
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Oh! What better way to show my
affection than
to write "gold" on your
forehead? All righty...
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
You might not realize it, but the fact
that you can
keep up with me makes you
a beast in your own
right.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Done! My handwriting isn't half bad, if I
do say so!
Bahaha! Now that's awesome!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
I wake up at the academy some time
later with
Голд Шип laughing in my face.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Bahaha! This is priceless!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
I don't find out it was because I have the
word
"gold" emblazoned on my forehead
until much,
much later.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
